snapshot.aria-label: Felix Andersson, back to the start

snapshot: Nearly six years building frontend infrastructure other teams depend on: Cisco’s Magnetic design system, the component library behind the Meraki Dashboard, and the Dashboard’s most used pages. Lately I’ve also been designing and building products of my own, end to end.
React and TypeScript components every Meraki team builds on.
Data-heavy dashboards, large tables, deeply nested forms.
A startup’s whole frontend, OKR epics, problem to release.
The review pipeline my team runs on every push.
